id: title:dmarchuk:offer an email when a flag goes live for everyone

review.posthog_relevance: Adds a workflow and UI interaction for the Feature Flag product, specifically the 'Live Broadcast' cohort creation capability.
review.reason: The change implements a substantive, bounded capability: it adds the backend and frontend wiring for a new user action (broadcasting a cohort) and its supporting UI components (toast, button, constants). This is not merely documentation or a minor behavior correction; it establishes a new feature path. However, the tier is not 3 because the implementation does not demonstrate a 'b'
review.uncertainty: The review relies solely on the supplied hunk observations. While the code structure supports the new capability, the actual benefit to PostHog users (e.g., increased cohort sharing, reduced support tickets) and the reliability of the broadcast mechanism are not independently verified by this patch alone. No adoption or incident avoidance is inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are used. No tier is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds the flagWentLive export and its supporting isOnForEveryone and liveFlagToastOptions, and wire them into saveFeatureFlagSuccess and updateFeatureFlagActiveSuccess. P1.F2.H4, P1.F2.H11, P1.F2.H12.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether a flag save transitioned from not-on-for-everyone to on-for-everyone, and if so, attaches a toast with a button to broadcast the cohort. This could help users discover the cohort and share it, rather than relying on manual sharing or missing the cohort entirely.

observations.behavior: Adds the FLAG_LIVE_BROADCAST_SOURCE constant and its use in the broadcast action. P1.F2.H3, P1.F2.H9, P1.F2.H13.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a distinct source identifier for the broadcast cohort, distinguishing it from other broadcast sources. This could help distinguish and potentially prioritize or filter these broadcasts in downstream processing or analytics.

observations.behavior: Adds the ToastButton import and its use in liveFlagToastOptions. P1.F2.H1, P1.F2.H4.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the toast to include an actionable button, enabling users to initiate the broadcast cohort creation. This could help users discover the cohort and share it, rather than relying on manual sharing or missing the cohort entirely.
